1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Fighter list.

1.name: Fighting Style
1.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. The chosen style modifies your attack rolls, damage, or AC depending on the option.

1.name: Second Wind
1.description: You can use a Bonus Action to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of three Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 3 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Action Surge
2.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, take one additional action on your turn.

2.name: Tactical Mind
2.description: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining Hit Points, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.

3.name: Fighter Subclass
3.description: Choose a subclass that shapes your fighting style for the rest of your career.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Tactical Shift
5.description: Whenever you activate your Second Wind with a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Ability Score Improvement
6.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

9.name: Indomitable
9.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail; if you do so, you must use the new roll and can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest. Uses per Long Rest: 1 at L9, 2 at L13, 3 at L17. Spend a use here when you retry the save.

9.name: Tactical Master
9.description: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.

11.name: Two Extra Attacks
11.description: You can attack three times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

13.name: Indomitable
13.description: Your Indomitable pool grows to 2 uses per Long Rest. (The pool is shared with the base Indomitable feature — no separate uses to track.)

13.name: Studied Attacks
13.description: You study your opponents and learn from each attack you make. If you make an attack roll against a creature and miss, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

14.name: Ability Score Improvement
14.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

17.name: Action Surge
17.description: Starting at level 17, you can use your Action Surge feature twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

17.name: Indomitable
17.description: Your Indomitable pool grows to 3 uses per Long Rest. (The pool is shared with the base Indomitable feature — no separate uses to track.)

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Three Extra Attacks
20.description: You can attack four times instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: A Fighter who focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. The simplicity of the archetype makes it ideal for newcomers, while still offering elite martial output.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

7.name: Remarkable Athlete
7.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

10.name: Additional Fighting Style
10.description: You can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

18.name: Survivor
18.description: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Wizard list.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You know three cantrips and have a spellbook with six 1st-level spells.

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.description: Once per day after a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots up to half your Wizard level.

1.name: Ritual Adept
1.description: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook. You needn't have the spell prepared, but you must read from the book to cast a spell in this way.

2.name: Scholar
2.description: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study. Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

3.name: Wizard Subclass
3.description: Choose a Wizard subclass (an Arcane Tradition); you gain its features of your Wizard level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

5.name: Memorize Spell
5.description: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells you have prepared for your Spellcasting feature with another level 1+ spell from the book.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

18.name: Spell Mastery
18.description: You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell in your spellbook that have a casting time of an action. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot. To cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of those spells with an eligible spell of the same level from the book.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Signature Spells
20.description: Choose two level 3 spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each of them once at level 3 without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't cast them in this way again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. To cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot.

subclasses.name: Evoker
subclasses.description: You focus your study on magic that channels raw elemental energy — and on hurling it precisely past your allies.

3.name: Evocation Savant
3.description: Choose two Wizard evocation spells (level 2 or lower) and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain a Wizard level thereafter, you can add one Wizard evocation spell of a castable level the same way.

3.name: Potent Cantrip
3.description: Your damaging cantrips hit even on a miss or successful save: the target takes half the cantrip's damage (round it manually) and suffers no additional effect.

6.name: Sculpt Spells
6.description: When you cast an evocation spell, you can protect creatures you can see equal to 1 + the spell's level: they automatically succeed on their saves against it and take no damage if they would take half.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard evocation spell you cast (add it manually to the rolled total).

14.name: Overchannel
14.description: When you cast a Wizard spell of level 1–5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with it (use the Maximize crit-style idea manually). First use per Long Rest is safe; each later use deals you 2d12 Necrotic per spell level, increasing by 1d12 each additional time.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 4 skills from your Rogue list.

1.name: Expertise
1.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At level 6, you gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies.

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to a creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. You don't need Advantage if an ally is within 5 feet of the target, the ally isn't Incapacitated, and you don't have Disadvantage. The extra damage matches the weapon's damage type and scales with your rogue level.

1.name: Thieves' Cant
1.description: You know Thieves' Cant — a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. You also know one other language of your choice.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of two Simple or Martial weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: On your turn, you can take one of the following as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

grantedActions.name: Dash
grantedActions.description: Gain extra movement equal to your Speed for the current turn.

grantedActions.name: Disengage
grantedActions.description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the turn.

grantedActions.name: Hide
grantedActions.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to hide, per the Hide action.

3.name: Rogue Subclass
3.description: Choose a subclass that shapes your roguish style for the rest of your career.

3.name: Steady Aim
3.description: As a Bonus Action, give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. You can only use this if you haven't moved this turn, and after using it your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

5.name: Cunning Strike
5.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one Cunning Strike effect by forgoing the listed number of Sneak Attack dice (DC = 8 + DEX mod + Proficiency Bonus). Initial options: Poison (1d6) — Con save or Poisoned for 1 minute; Trip (1d6) — Dex save or Prone (Large or smaller); Withdraw (1d6) — move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: When a visible attacker hits you, use your Reaction to halve the damage (round down).

grantedActions.name: Uncanny Dodge
grantedActions.description: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack roll, use your Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

6.name: Expertise
6.description: Gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies of your choice.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 more skill proficiencies for Expertise

7.name: Evasion
7.description: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

7.name: Reliable Talent
7.description: When making an ability check using a skill or tool proficiency, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

10.name: Ability Score Improvement
10.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

11.name: Improved Cunning Strike
11.description: You can use up to two Cunning Strike effects when dealing Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

14.name: Devious Strikes
14.description: You learn new Cunning Strike options: Daze (2d6) — Con save or on its next turn it can only do one of move, action, or bonus action; Knock Out (6d6) — Con save or Unconscious for 1 minute (repeats save each turn); Obscure (3d6) — Dex save or Blinded until the end of its next turn.

15.name: Slippery Mind
15.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify.

18.name: Elusive
18.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.description: If you fail a D20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: A classic adventurer who hunts for treasure. Thieves are skilled at climbing, jumping, using items quickly, and eventually attuning to more magic items than usual.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following: make a Sleight of Hand check to pick a lock, disarm a trap, or pick a pocket; take the Utilize action; or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires it.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: Climber: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Jumper: Determine jump distance using your Dexterity rather than Strength.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: You learn the Stealth Attack Cunning Strike option. When you deal Sneak Attack damage and have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover. Cost: 1d6.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: Attunement: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. Charges: When using a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a 6, use it without expending charges. Scrolls: You can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. Cantrips and level 1 spells work reliably; for higher levels, succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 + spell level) or the scroll disintegrates.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.description: You take two turns during the first round of any combat. Your first turn is at your normal Initiative; your second turn is at Initiative minus 10.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Barbarian list.

1.name: Rage
1.description: You can enter a Rage as a Bonus Action. While raging, melee weapon attacks you make with Strength deal extra damage (Rage Damage). The Rage lasts up to 10 rounds and ends early if you don't attack or take damage on your turn.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice, such as Greataxes and Handaxes. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices. When you reach certain Barbarian levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Barbarian Features table.

2.name: Danger Sense
2.description: You gain an uncanny sense of when things aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge perils. You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

2.name: Reckless Attack
2.description: Toggle on at the start of your turn to gain Advantage on your Strength-based melee weapon attack rolls this turn — in the app this grants Advantage on all your weapon attacks (the SRD scope is honor-system for ranged/finesse). The downside — attackers gain Advantage on attack rolls against you until your next turn — is not automatically applied (no enemy sheet).

3.name: Barbarian Subclass
3.description: Choose a Barbarian subclass (a Primal Path); you gain its features of your Barbarian level or lower.

3.name: Primal Knowledge
3.description: You gain proficiency in another skill of your choice from the skill list available to Barbarians at level 1. In addition, while your Rage is active, you can channel primal power when you attempt certain tasks; whenever you make an ability check using one of the following skills, you can make it as a Strength check even if it normally uses a different ability: Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Fast Movement
5.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. (Folded into the Speed chip.)

7.name: Feral Instinct
7.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. In addition, when you roll Initiative and are Surprised, you can act normally on your first turn (honor-system, mention at the table). The Init chip on the sheet shows '(Adv)' while this feature is granted.

7.name: Instinctive Pounce
7.description: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

9.name: Brutal Strike
9.description: When you make an attack roll on your turn, you can forgo Reckless Attack's Advantage to deal an extra 1d10 Force damage on hit. Choose one Brutal Strike effect (Forceful Blow: shove the target 15 ft; Hamstring Blow: reduce target speed by 15 ft) — the extra damage is auto-added as an opt-in rider chip on the damage tab; the target-side rider effect is honor-system. At Barbarian 13, you can apply two Brutal Strike effects per attack; at 17, three.

11.name: Relentless Rage
11.description: Your Rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 Hit Points while your Rage is active and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw; if you succeed, your Hit Points instead change to a number equal to twice your Barbarian level. Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5, until you finish a Short or Long Rest, when the DC resets to 10.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

13.name: Improved Brutal Strike
13.description: You have honed new ways to attack furiously. The following effects are now among your Brutal Strike options: Staggering Blow (the target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw and can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn) and Sundering Blow (before the start of your next turn, the next attack roll made by another creature against the target gains a +5 bonus; an attack roll can gain only one Sundering Blow bonus).

15.name: Persistent Rage
15.description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage; you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. In addition, your Rage is now so fierce that it lasts for 10 minutes without you needing to do anything to extend it from round to round. Your Rage ends early if you have the Unconscious condition (not just the Incapacitated condition) or don Heavy armor.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't increase a score above 20. Alternatively, you can forgo the increase and take a feat.

17.name: Improved Brutal Strike
17.description: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10. In addition, you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.

18.name: Indomitable Might
18.description: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total. In the app: the d20 for STR checks / STR saves / STR-based skill checks (Athletics) is pre-floored so `d20 + STR mod` is always at least your STR score.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Primal Champion
20.description: You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.description: You channel your Rage into violent fury, frenzying beyond the limits of ordinary warriors.

3.name: Frenzy
3.description: While your Rage is active and you use Reckless Attack, the first creature you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack takes extra damage equal to your Rage Damage bonus in d6s (2d6, 3d6 at level 9, 4d6 at level 16). (The chip below the attack roll adds the dice — only use it while raging and attacking recklessly.)

6.name: Mindless Rage
6.description: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active; if you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition is suspended for the Rage's duration. (Apply/remove the conditions manually.)

10.name: Retaliation
10.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against it (use your weapon's normal attack roll).

14.name: Intimidating Presence
14.description: As a Bonus Action, creatures of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation must succeed on a Wisdom save (DC shown) or be Frightened until the start of your next turn. Once per Long Rest free; afterwards it costs a Rage use (track manually).

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Paladin list.

1.name: Lay on Hands
1.description: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature and draw from the pool to restore Hit Points equal to the amount you spend (maximum: 5 × your Paladin level). You can also expend 5 points to remove the Poisoned condition. Spend from the pool below; v1 has no targeted-heal prompt.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast prepared Paladin spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of two Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. The chosen style modifies your attack rolls, damage, or AC depending on the option.

2.name: Paladin's Smite
2.description: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon, you can expend a spell slot to deal extra Radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

3.name: Channel Divinity
3.description: You can channel divine energy to fuel magical effects granted by your subclass. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Paladin Subclass
3.description: Choose a Paladin subclass (a Sacred Oath); you gain its features of your Paladin level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Faithful Steed
5.description: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared, and you can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain that free use when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Aura of Protection
6.description: You and allies within 10 feet of you gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) while you are conscious. (Mechanical save bonus not yet applied automatically — add it to rolls manually.)

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

9.name: Abjure Foes
9.description: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of this class's Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. As you present your Holy Symbol or weapon, you can target a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While Frightened in this way, a target can do only one of the following on its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action.

10.name: Aura of Courage
10.description: You and allies within 10 feet of you have Immunity to the Frightened condition while you are conscious.

11.name: Radiant Strikes
11.description: Your strikes carry divine power: when you hit with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage. (Not yet folded into damage rolls automatically — add 1d8 radiant manually.)

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

14.name: Restoring Touch
14.description: When you use Lay on Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of these conditions: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. Each removed condition costs 5 points from the pool.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

18.name: Aura Expansion
18.description: Your Aura of Protection extends to 30 feet instead of 10 feet.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.description: The ideal of the knight in shining armor: honesty, courage, compassion, and duty bound into a sacred oath.

3.name: Devotion Spells
3.description: Your oath keeps certain spells always prepared — L3: Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith; L5: Aid, Zone of Truth; L9: Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic; L13: Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith; L17: Commune, Flame Strike. (Only Shield of Faith is bundled so far; the rest are text-only until authored.)

3.name: Sacred Weapon
3.description: When you take the Attack action, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to imbue one weapon for 10 minutes: add your Charisma modifier to its attack rolls (add it manually), and it sheds 20 feet of bright light.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.description: You and your allies within your Aura of Protection can't be Charmed while you're conscious.

15.name: Smite of Protection
15.description: Whenever you use Divine Smite, you and your allies in your Aura of Protection gain Half Cover until the start of your next turn.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.description: As a Bonus Action, emanate a sun-bright aura for 10 minutes: at the start of each of your turns, enemies in your Aura of Protection take Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus (apply manually), and you have Advantage on saves forced by Fiends and Undead. Once per Long Rest, or expend a level-5 spell slot.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Cleric list.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast prepared Cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus, and you can cast prepared Cleric spells with the Ritual tag as rituals.

1.name: Divine Order
1.description: You have dedicated yourself to one sacred role. Protector: trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor. Thaumaturge: you know one extra Cleric cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier to Arcana and Religion checks. (Picks are recorded; the granted proficiencies/cantrip aren't auto-applied yet.)

options.name: Protector
options.description: Trained for battle: gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

options.name: Thaumaturge
options.description: You know one extra Cleric cantrip, and add your Wisdom modifier to Intelligence (Arcana) and Intelligence (Religion) checks.

2.name: Channel Divinity
2.description: You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes. Divine Spark (Magic action): point your Holy Symbol at a creature within 30 feet — roll 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier and either restore that many Hit Points or force a Constitution save against that much Radiant or Necrotic damage (half on success). The d8 becomes 2d8 at level 7, 3d8 at 13, and 4d8 at 18 — add the extra dice manually for now. Turn Undead (Magic action): each undead within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute. You regain one expended use on a Short Rest, and all uses on a Long Rest.

3.name: Cleric Subclass
3.description: You gain a Cleric subclass of your choice, a specialization that grants you features at level 3 and again at levels 6 and 17.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

5.name: Sear Undead
5.description: Whenever you use Turn Undead, you can roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die) — each undead that fails its save takes Radiant damage equal to the roll's total. This damage doesn't end the turn effect.

7.name: Blessed Strikes
7.description: Divine power infuses you in battle. Divine Strike: once per turn when you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage. Potent Spellcasting: add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips. (Picks are recorded; the bonus damage isn't auto-applied yet.)

options.name: Divine Strike
options.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon, deal an extra 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage.

options.name: Potent Spellcasting
options.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with your Cleric cantrips.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

10.name: Divine Intervention
10.description: You can call on your deity to intervene: as a Magic action, cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without expending a spell slot or needing material components. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

14.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
14.description: Your Blessed Strikes option improves. Divine Strike: the extra damage increases to 2d8. Potent Spellcasting: when you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet — temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Take a General feat: Ability Score Improvement, Grappler, or any General feat for which you qualify.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Greater Divine Intervention
20.description: When you use Divine Intervention, you can cast Wish with it. When you do, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.description: The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life: soothing the hurt and the sick, and standing against the forces of death.

3.name: Disciple of Life
3.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points, the target regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 + the slot's level. (Add the bonus manually for now.)

3.name: Life Domain Spells
3.description: You always have certain spells prepared: Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Mass Healing Word, Revivify, and more as you gain levels. (Only some of these are in the bundled spell list so far — add the rest from the picker when authored.)

3.name: Preserve Life
3.description: Channel Divinity option (Magic action): present your Holy Symbol and distribute Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (none can exceed half its HP max). Spend one Channel Divinity use from the resources card when you use this.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.description: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well: when you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to a creature other than you, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 + the slot's level.

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll — use the highest number possible for each die.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: You gain proficiency in any three skills of your choice.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You cast Bard spells using Charisma. You know two cantrips from the Bard list and prepare Bard spells from the whole list (4 to start, growing with level). You can cast any prepared spell with the Ritual tag as a ritual, and use a Musical Instrument as your spellcasting focus.

1.name: Bardic Inspiration
1.description: As a Bonus Action, inspire a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you, giving it a Bardic Inspiration die (d6). Within the next hour, once, it can roll the die and add it to a failed D20 Test. Uses equal to your Charisma modifier; regain on a Long Rest. The die grows to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, and d12 at level 15.

2.name: Expertise
2.description: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice (your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for checks with them).

2.name: Jack of All Trades
2.description: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill you lack proficiency in and that doesn't already use your Proficiency Bonus. (Apply manually.)

3.name: Bard Subclass
3.description: Choose a Bard college (subclass). You gain its features of your Bard level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

5.name: Font of Inspiration
5.description: You regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action) to regain one expended use. (Short-rest recovery is tracked manually for now — the pool refreshes on a Long Rest.)

7.name: Countercharm
7.description: As a Reaction, when you or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against being Charmed or Frightened, you can cause that save to be rerolled with Advantage.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

9.name: Expertise
9.description: You gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 more skill proficiencies for Expertise

10.name: Magical Secrets
10.description: Whenever your number of prepared spells increases, you may choose those new spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists; they count as Bard spells for you. (Cross-list prepared spells are tracked manually.)

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

18.name: Superior Inspiration
18.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two (if you had fewer).

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Words of Creation
20.description: You always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared. When you cast either, you can target a second creature within 10 feet of the first.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.description: Bards who collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, excelling at versatility and turning others' efforts against them.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.description: As a Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and subtract the rolled die from the creature's roll — reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

6.name: Magical Discoveries
6.description: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists (cantrip or a level you have slots for). You always have them prepared; they count as Bard spells.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.description: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, roll the die, and add it — potentially turning the failure into a success. On a failure, the use isn't expended.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Religion.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma. You know four cantrips and prepare Sorcerer spells from the whole list (2 to start, growing with level). You can use an Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

1.name: Innate Sorcery
1.description: As a Bonus Action, unleash your innate magic for 1 minute: your Sorcerer spell save DC increases by 1, and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast. Two uses; regain on a Long Rest.

2.name: Font of Magic
2.description: You have Sorcery Points (equal to your Sorcerer level from level 2 on) that fuel Metamagic and other options. Convert a spell slot to Sorcery Points equal to its level (no action); or, as a Bonus Action, spend Sorcery Points to create a spell slot (1st=2, 2nd=3, 3rd=5, 4th=6, 5th=7 SP; max 5th). Regain all on a Long Rest.

2.name: Metamagic
2.description: You can alter your spells. Choose Metamagic options (2 at level 2, 4 at level 10, 6 at level 17); spend Sorcery Points to apply them.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.description: 1 SP: when you cast a spell forcing saves, choose up to your Charisma modifier of creatures to automatically succeed (and take no damage if they'd take half).

options.name: Distant Spell
options.description: 1 SP: double a spell's range (or make a Touch spell 30 ft).

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.description: 1 SP: reroll up to your Charisma modifier of a spell's damage dice. Stacks with one other Metamagic option.

options.name: Extended Spell
options.description: 1 SP: double a spell's duration (max 24 hours); Advantage on Concentration saves for it.

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.description: 2 SP: give one target Disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.description: 2 SP: change an Action-cast spell to a Bonus Action for this casting.

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.description: 1 SP: when you miss with a spell attack, reroll the d20. Stacks with one other Metamagic option.

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.description: 1 SP: cast a spell without Verbal, Somatic, or (non-costly) Material components.

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.description: 1 SP: change a spell's Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison/Thunder damage to another of those types.

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.description: 1 SP: when you cast a spell that can be upcast to add a target, increase its effective level by 1 to target one more creature.

3.name: Sorcerer Subclass
3.description: Choose a Sorcerer subclass; you gain its features of your Sorcerer level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

5.name: Sorcerous Restoration
5.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain expended Sorcery Points up to half your Sorcerer level (round down), once per Long Rest. (Short-rest recovery is tracked manually.)

7.name: Sorcery Incarnate
7.description: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can activate it by spending 2 Sorcery Points. While Innate Sorcery is active, you can use up to two Metamagic options on each spell you cast.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

10.name: Metamagic
10.description: You learn two more Metamagic options (handled by the Metamagic picker, which now allows 4 picks).

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

17.name: Metamagic
17.description: You learn two more Metamagic options (the Metamagic picker now allows 6 picks).

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Arcane Apotheosis
20.description: While your Innate Sorcery is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

subclasses.name: Draconic Sorcery
subclasses.description: Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon, granting draconic resilience, elemental affinity, and eventually wings.

3.name: Draconic Resilience
3.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 again each time you gain a Sorcerer level. While you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier. (HP/AC are tracked manually for now.)

3.name: Draconic Spells
3.description: You always have certain spells prepared at given Sorcerer levels — L3: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; L5: Fear, Fly; L7: Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; L9: Legend Lore, Summon Dragon. (Authored as text; these spells aren't all bundled yet.)

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.description: Choose a damage type associated with dragons (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison). You have Resistance to it, and when you cast a spell that deals that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

options.name: Acid
options.description: Resistance to Acid; add CHA to one Acid damage roll.

options.name: Cold
options.description: Resistance to Cold; add CHA to one Cold damage roll.

options.name: Fire
options.description: Resistance to Fire; add CHA to one Fire damage roll.

options.name: Lightning
options.description: Resistance to Lightning; add CHA to one Lightning damage roll.

options.name: Poison
options.description: Resistance to Poison; add CHA to one Poison damage roll.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.description: As a Bonus Action, sprout draconic wings for 1 hour (or until dismissed), gaining a Fly Speed of 60 feet. Once per Long Rest, or by spending 3 Sorcery Points to restore the use.

18.name: Dragon Companion
18.description: You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component, and once without a spell slot (regaining that use on a Long Rest).

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Druid list.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You can cast prepared Druid spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. After a Long Rest you can change your prepared spells; you can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus, and cast prepared Druid spells with the Ritual tag as rituals.

1.name: Druidic
1.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids, and can use it to leave hidden messages. You also always have the Druidcraft cantrip prepared (it doesn't count against your cantrips known).

1.name: Primal Order
1.description: You have dedicated yourself to a sacred role. Magician: you know one extra Druid cantrip and add your Wisdom modifier to your Intelligence (Arcana / Nature) checks — the skill-check bonus is auto-applied on the sheet; the extra cantrip is still honor-system. Warden: you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and Medium armor (honor-system; the picks are recorded but proficiencies not yet auto-granted).

options.name: Magician
options.description: One extra Druid cantrip; add WIS to Arcana and Nature checks.

options.name: Warden
options.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and Medium armor.

2.name: Wild Shape
2.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use to transform into a Beast form you've learned (Wild Shape forms aren't modeled on the sheet yet — track your assumed form manually). You regain one use on a Short Rest and all uses on a Long Rest.

2.name: Wild Companion
2.description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast the Find Familiar spell without Material components; the familiar is Fey and lasts a number of hours equal to half your Druid level.

3.name: Druid Subclass
3.description: Choose a Druid subclass (a Primal Circle); you gain its features of your Druid level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

5.name: Wild Resurgence
5.description: Once on each of your turns, if you have no uses of Wild Shape left, you can give yourself one use by expending a spell slot (no action required). In addition, you can expend one use of Wild Shape (no action required) to give yourself a level 1 spell slot, but you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

7.name: Elemental Fury
7.description: The might of the elements flows through you. You gain one of the following options of your choice: Potent Spellcasting (add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Druid cantrip) or Primal Strike (once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or a Beast form's attack in Wild Shape, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, chosen when you hit).

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

15.name: Improved Elemental Fury
15.description: The option you chose for Elemental Fury grows more powerful: if you chose Potent Spellcasting, when you cast a Druid cantrip with a range of 10 feet or greater, the spell's range increases by 300 feet; if you chose Primal Strike, the extra damage of your Primal Strike increases to 2d8.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

18.name: Beast Spells
18.description: While using Wild Shape, you can cast spells with Verbal and Somatic components, using your beast form's mouth and limbs to satisfy them.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Archdruid
20.description: Your Wild Shape uses are effectively unlimited, you ignore Verbal/Somatic/Material components of Druid spells, and you can convert unexpended spell slots into Wild Shape uses. You also age more slowly.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: A mystic druid whose magic is shaped by a chosen land — arid, polar, temperate, or tropical — granting extra prepared spells and the ability to recover magic by communing with nature.

3.name: Circle of the Land
3.description: Choose a type of land at Druid L3. While in this Circle you always have that land's Circle Spells prepared at Druid levels 3 / 5 / 7 / 9 (all four lands' full spell lists are wired — Arid, Polar, Temperate, Tropical). You also learn one extra Druid cantrip (honor-system for now; add it from Add Spell).

options.name: Arid
options.description: Deserts and savannahs — fire and lightning magic.

options.name: Polar
options.description: Frozen lands — cold and control magic.

options.name: Temperate
options.description: Forests and grasslands — lightning and movement magic.

options.name: Tropical
options.description: Jungles and swamps — poison, acid, and illusion magic.

3.name: Land's Aid
3.description: As a Magic action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to channel life force into a point within 60 feet: one creature there makes a Constitution save (your spell save DC), taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failure (half on success), and a different creature of your choice there regains 2d6 Hit Points. Both dice increase by 1d6 at Druid levels 10 (+1d6) and 14 (+1d6).

6.name: Natural Recovery
6.description: You can cast one of your circle spells without a spell slot once per Long Rest. Additionally, when you finish a Short Rest you can recover expended spell slots whose combined level is up to half your Druid level (rounded up); none can be 6th level or higher. (Slot recovery is tracked manually.)

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.description: You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your circle's land. You also can't be charmed or frightened by Elementals or Fey.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.description: As a Magic action, you create a 15-foot Cube of protective energy within 120 feet for 1 minute. You and your allies in it have Half Cover and gain your choice of resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage; you can move the Cube 60 feet as a Bonus Action.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Warlock list.

1.name: Pact Magic
1.description: You can cast prepared Warlock spells using Charisma. Your Pact Magic slots are all the same level (shown in the Spells tab), and you regain all of them on a Short or Long Rest.

1.name: Eldritch Invocations
1.description: You gain eldritch invocations of your choice — magical abilities powered by your patron. You gain more as you level and can swap one whenever you gain a Warlock level. (Invocation mechanics are tracked as text; apply their effects manually.)

options.name: Agonizing Blast
options.description: When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma modifier to each beam's damage.

options.name: Armor of Shadows
options.description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself at will, without a spell slot.

options.name: Devil's Sight
options.description: You can see normally in dim light, darkness, and magical darkness to 120 feet.

options.name: Eldritch Spear
options.description: Your Eldritch Blast range increases to 300 feet.

options.name: Fiendish Vigor
options.description: You can cast False Life on yourself at will as a level-1 spell, without a spell slot.

options.name: Mask of Many Faces
options.description: You can cast Disguise Self at will, without a spell slot.

options.name: Misty Visions
options.description: You can cast Silent Image at will, without a spell slot.

options.name: One with Shadows
options.description: In dim light or darkness you can become Invisible as a Magic action; it ends when you move or act.

options.name: Otherworldly Leap
options.description: You can cast Jump on yourself at will, without a spell slot.

options.name: Repelling Blast
options.description: When you hit a Large-or-smaller creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push it 10 feet away.

options.name: Pact of the Blade
options.description: Conjure a pact weapon as a Bonus Action; you can attack with your Charisma modifier and its damage is magical.

options.name: Pact of the Chain
options.description: You learn Find Familiar and can take special familiar forms (imp, sprite, etc.).

options.name: Pact of the Tome
options.description: Your Book of Shadows grants three extra cantrips from any class list and two level-1 ritual spells.

2.name: Magical Cunning
2.description: Once per Long Rest, you can perform a 1-minute rite to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots equal to half your maximum (round up).

3.name: Warlock Subclass
3.description: Choose a Warlock subclass (an Otherworldly Patron); you gain its features at your Warlock level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

9.name: Contact Patron
9.description: You always have the Contact Other Plane spell prepared; once per Long Rest you can cast it without a slot to contact your patron, automatically succeeding on the save. (Spell not yet bundled — narrate the result.)

11.name: Mystic Arcanum
11.description: Your patron grants you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast your arcanum spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

13.name: Mystic Arcanum
13.description: As shown in the Warlock Features table, you gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way: choose one level 7 Warlock spell as an additional arcanum. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the use when you finish a Long Rest.

15.name: Mystic Arcanum
15.description: As shown in the Warlock Features table, you gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way: choose one level 8 Warlock spell as an additional arcanum. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the use when you finish a Long Rest.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

17.name: Mystic Arcanum
17.description: As shown in the Warlock Features table, you gain another Warlock spell of your choice that can be cast in this way: choose one level 9 Warlock spell as an additional arcanum. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the use when you finish a Long Rest.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Eldritch Master
20.description: When you use Magical Cunning, you regain ALL your expended Pact Magic spell slots.

subclasses.name: Fiend Patron
subclasses.description: You have struck a bargain with a fiend of the Lower Planes, gaining destructive gifts of fire and desperate luck.

3.name: Dark One's Blessing
3.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, or an enemy within 10 feet of you drops to 0, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (add them manually via the HP editor).

3.name: Fiend Spells
3.description: You always have certain spells prepared — L3: Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion; L5: Fireball, Stinking Cloud; L7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; L9: Geas, Insect Plague. (Only Command is bundled so far; the rest are text-only until authored.)

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.description: When you make an ability check or saving throw, you can add 1d10 after seeing the roll but before its effects. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (min 1), regained on a Long Rest.

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.description: Choose a damage type when you finish a Short or Long Rest; you have Resistance to it until you choose a different one. (Track your chosen resistance manually.)

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.description: Once per Long Rest when you hit a creature with an attack, you can instantly transport it through the Lower Planes; it takes 8d10 Psychic damage (fiends are immune) and returns at the end of your next turn.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 2 skills from your Monk list.

1.name: Martial Arts
1.description: Your martial-arts training lets you use Dexterity for unarmed strikes and Monk weapons (Simple melee weapons + Martial melee weapons with the Light property), and your Martial Arts die replaces their normal damage: 1d6, becoming 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 11, and 1d12 at level 17. You can also make one unarmed strike as a Bonus Action.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While you wear no armor and wield no Shield, your base AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

2.name: Monk's Focus
2.description: You channel a well of Focus points to power your techniques. You have Focus points equal to your Monk level and regain all of them on a Short or Long Rest.

2.name: Flurry of Blows
2.description: Spend 1 Focus point to make two unarmed strikes as a Bonus Action (tap to spend, then roll your Unarmed Strike twice).

2.name: Patient Defense
2.description: As a Bonus Action you can Disengage for free, or spend 1 Focus point (tap) to take both the Disengage and Dodge actions.

2.name: Step of the Wind
2.description: As a Bonus Action you can Dash for free, or spend 1 Focus point (tap) to Dash and Disengage and double your jump distance.

2.name: Unarmored Movement
2.description: Your speed increases while you wear no armor and wield no Shield (+10 ft, growing to +30 ft at level 18; already folded into the Speed chip).

2.name: Uncanny Metabolism
2.description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended Focus Points. When you do so, roll your Martial Arts die, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Monk level plus the number rolled. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Monk Subclass
3.description: Choose a Monk subclass (a Monastic Tradition); you gain its features of your Monk level or lower.

3.name: Deflect Attacks
3.description: When you're hit by a Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing attack, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + DEX + your Monk level. If you reduce it to 0, you can spend 1 Focus point to redirect the attack (track the Focus point manually).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

4.name: Slow Fall
4.description: Use your Reaction when you fall to reduce the fall damage by five times your Monk level.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.description: Once per turn when you hit with a Monk weapon or unarmed strike, spend 1 Focus point (tap): the target makes a Constitution save vs the DC shown or is Stunned until the start of your next turn; on a success its Speed is halved and your next attack against it has Advantage.

6.name: Empowered Strikes
6.description: Your unarmed strikes can deal your choice of their normal damage type or Force damage, and count as magical.

7.name: Evasion
7.description: When you're subjected to a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure (unless Incapacitated).

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

9.name: Acrobatic Movement
9.description: While unarmored, you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling.

10.name: Heightened Focus
10.description: Flurry of Blows makes three strikes; Patient Defense also grants Temporary Hit Points equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die; Step of the Wind can carry a willing ally. (Apply the upgrades manually.)

10.name: Self-Restoration
10.description: At the end of each of your turns you can end the Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned condition on yourself; going without food or drink causes no Exhaustion.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

13.name: Deflect Energy
13.description: Deflect Attacks now works against attacks of any damage type.

14.name: Disciplined Survivor
14.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saves, and when you fail a saving throw you can spend 1 Focus point to reroll it (track the point manually).

15.name: Perfect Focus
15.description: When you roll Initiative with 3 or fewer Focus points and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain Focus points until you have 4.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

18.name: Superior Defense
18.description: At the start of your turn, spend 3 Focus points (tap) to gain Resistance to all damage except Force for 1 minute.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Body and Mind
20.description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25. (Adjust your scores manually.)

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
subclasses.description: A master of unarmed combat who turns an enemy's body against them with open-palm techniques.

3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.description: When you hit with a Flurry of Blows strike, impose one effect: Addle (no Opportunity Attacks until its next turn starts), Push (DEX save vs your Focus DC or be pushed 15 feet), or Topple (DEX save vs your Focus DC or fall Prone).

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.description: As a Bonus Action, roll your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier and regain that many Hit Points (apply as healing). Uses = your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

11.name: Fleet Step
11.description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately for free.

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.description: When you hit with an unarmed strike, spend 4 Focus points to start lethal vibrations. At the end of a later turn you can end them: the target makes a Constitution save vs your Focus DC, taking 10d12 Force on a failure or half on a success.

1.name: Skill Proficiencies
1.description: Choose 3 skills from your Ranger list.

1.name: Favored Enemy
1.description: You always have the **Hunter's Mark** spell prepared (it doesn't count against your prepared count). You can cast it a number of times per Long Rest without a spell slot; those free casts also don't require Concentration to be started until you spend a slot.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Your training with weapons lets you exploit each weapon's unique properties. You gain the Mastery property of two Simple or Martial weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, growing to three at Ranger level 9. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice with different weapons and change one of those weapon choices.

selection.prompt: Choose 2 weapons whose Mastery property you can use

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: You have learned to channel the magical essence of nature to cast spells. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Ranger spells, and you can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for them. The Ranger Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells, and you regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

2.name: Deft Explorer
2.description: You have expertise in one skill you're proficient in — chosen at creation via the Features tab. You also gain a second language of your choice and can use a shortcut through wilderness (track those manually).

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. The chosen style modifies your attack rolls, damage, or AC depending on the option.

3.name: Ranger Subclass
3.description: Choose a Ranger subclass (a Ranger Conclave); you gain its features of your Ranger level or lower.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

6.name: Nature's Shield
6.description: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, use your Reaction to become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force a save.

6.name: Roving
6.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

7.name: Subclass Feature
7.description: You gain a subclass feature at level 7 (see your subclass's L7 entry).

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

9.name: Expertise
9.description: Choose a second skill you're proficient in to gain Expertise (your proficiency bonus is doubled on ability checks with it).

selection.prompt: Choose a second skill for Expertise

10.name: Tireless
10.description: As a Magic action, you or a creature you touch gains Temp HP equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier. Uses = your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per Long Rest. You also reduce your Exhaustion by 1 whenever you finish a Short Rest.

11.name: Subclass Feature
11.description: You gain a subclass feature at level 11.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

13.name: Relentless Hunter
13.description: Taking damage doesn't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

14.name: Nature's Veil
14.description: As a Bonus Action, magically become Invisible until the start of your next turn. Uses = your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

15.name: Subclass Feature
15.description: You gain a subclass feature at level 15.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each (max 20); or take a feat.

17.name: Precise Hunter
17.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature you've cursed with Hunter's Mark.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Choose an Epic Boon feat. Each grants a +1 ability bump (raising the cap on that score to 30) plus a unique feature. Some Boons require the Spellcasting feature.

20.name: Foe Slayer
20.description: Whenever you deal damage to your Hunter's-Marked target, add 1d10 to that damage roll (add manually to the total).

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: A stalker of monstrous prey who studies their weaknesses and strikes them down before they can spread destruction.

3.name: Hunter's Lore
3.description: You learn key details about creatures you can see or have Hunter's Mark on — their damage vulnerabilities, resistances, immunities, and any condition immunities (the DM narrates).

3.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
3.description: When you hit a creature that's below its Hit Point maximum, deal an extra 1d8 damage (once per turn). This is your Hunter's Prey choice from the SRD's three; Horde Breaker and Giant Killer aren't authored yet — treat as text and swap manually.

7.name: Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde
7.description: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. This is your SRD Defensive Tactics choice from three — Multiattack Defense and Steel Will aren't authored, swap manually.

11.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Evasion
11.description: When you're subjected to a Dexterity save for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure. This is your Superior Hunter's Defense from three SRD options (Stand Against the Tide, Uncanny Dodge not authored).

15.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
15.description: Your Hunter's Prey damage die becomes 1d10 (bump the Colossus Slayer chip's damage manually until we scale it in a future pass).
